# What the `test` job installs: the packages the Hermes runtime provides to a
# plugin, every one at the version in Hermes's own uv.lock at the fork commit
# pinned in scanner-pins.json (9cfa68a1), so the tests run against what the
# gateways run. pytest is in that lock too.
#
# Not "whatever is newest": FastAPI 0.142 changed how an app lists its included
# routes and three route tests then fail on a harness assumption, not on the
# plugin. A newer version is tried by bumping it here in a pull request, and a
# fork pin that moves in scanner-pins.json is the moment to compare this file
# with the new lock again.
#
# The first block is what the tests import; the second is what those resolve to.
# The plugin itself has no third-party dependency (python_dependencies in
# plugin.yaml stays empty): none of this ships.
